hero.title: A network lab in your browser
hero.lead: Build networks from routers, switches, access points and computers, cable them, configure them and test them with ping, ipconfig and tracert. Practise troubleshooting on real faults from small businesses. No installation, no account.

build.title: Build a network
build.text: Drag devices onto the canvas and connect them with the right cable. Each device has real ports.

configure.title: Configure and test
configure.text: Set IP addresses, VLANs and routes, then run ping, ipconfig, nslookup and tracert on the computers.

troubleshoot.title: Practise troubleshooting
troubleshoot.text: Exercises give you a broken small business network. Find the wrong setting, fix it and verify.

exercisesHint: Start with any exercise you like.
exercisesLead: Each exercise starts with a message from a small business. Inspect the devices, find the wrong setting, fix it and press Verify.
